build_anytoany_pipeline: build a multimodal generation pipeline that generates text from any combination of images, video, audio, and text inputs
run_chat_conversation: run a conversational chat pipeline that accepts role-based message dicts with multimodal content and continues the conversation
generate_text_from_image: generate descriptive text from an image input using a multimodal language model pipeline
return_generated_tensors: return raw token ID tensors instead of decoded text from the multimodal generation pipeline
generate_audio_output: generate audio output instead of text by setting generation_mode to audio in the pipeline
